Definition: Steadfast love, mercy and loyal covenant kindness — God's unfailing commitment to His people that never depends on their worthiness.
BiblicalUsage: Hesed appears over 250 times, most often of God. The Psalms repeat it in refrain — 'His steadfast love endures forever' — and the prophets call Israel to practice hesed toward others, not just feel it.
TheologicalSignificance: Hesed is the love that will not let go. It assures believers that God's kindness is covenant loyalty, not mood — a firm anchor when feelings and circumstances shift.
RelatedTopics: Grace; Mercy; Covenant; Love of God
